Whether omission reflects company judgment of 'immateriality' unstated in source → 4Q26 10-K checkpoint maintained. 11/12 SF Superior Court complaint original text and case number remain unconfirmed / 2026-11-14 established: four nonprofits (Alliance for Secure AI, Irreplaceable Education Fund, Public Citizen, Heat Initiative) filed 11/12 in San Francisco Superior Court against Anthropic, Google, Meta, OpenAI, SpaceX AI division under California unfair competition law — sought restraining order prohibiting frontier model development beyond current state of the art (per reports).
